issues.description: The problem text instructs students to use StringBuilder for the Animal name attribute for efficient string manipulations, but the UML in the problem statement and the reference solution both define the name as a String. This conflicting guidance about the name attribute's type (StringBuilder vs String) creates ambiguity about the expected attribute type and getter/setter signatures and may lead to student confusion or wrong implementations compared to the solution/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification consistent: either (A) update the UML and all textual references to state the name attribute is a StringBuilder and adjust the solution/template to use StringBuilder for the name (including getter/setter signatures returning/accepting StringBuilder), or (B) remove/modify the textual instruction to use StringBuilder and explicitly state the name attribute is a String (matching the UML and the provided solution). Ensure the tests and example code (Main) use the same type.
